faqPage.sub: Straight answers for hosts, coaches, and the people who join them.

faqPage.finalTitle: Still curious? The best way to learn is to host.

whatIs.a: ZoheeWell is one place where wellness hosts, coaches, and creators run their work: create events and retreats, sell tickets, teach courses, share resources, and stay in touch with their community. People looking for something to join can browse public events, resources, and coaches — no account needed to look.

whoFor.a: Hosts, coaches, educators, fitness professionals, creators, and community organizers — and everyone who wants to discover what they offer. Accounts are for people 18 and older; an adult can register a minor for an eligible event with separate guardian consent.

cost.a: Browsing Discover is free and needs no account, and guests can RSVP to events without one. Hosts start on the Free plan at $0 and only choose a paid plan when they need more room to grow.

create.q: How do I create an event?
create.a: Create a free account, then start a new event from your Events page. Add the details, choose free or paid tickets, and share your link. One-time and recurring events are both supported.

rsvp.q: How do RSVPs, capacity, and waitlists work?
rsvp.a: You set the capacity for each event. Guests RSVP from your link without needing an account, and when an event fills up, interested people can join the waitlist.

checkin.a: Each registration gets a QR code. At the door, you or your check-in staff scan codes from the event's check-in page — no printed lists needed.

reminders.q: Can I send reminders and follow-ups?
reminders.a: Yes. The Communications hub includes bilingual templates, automations for registrations, reminders, and cancellations, and multi-step journeys. Email is built in; SMS is a paid option that works once it is configured for your account.

retreats.q: Can I run a retreat or multi-day event?
retreats.a: Yes. Events can span multiple days, with tickets, waivers, and guardian consent when an adult registers a minor. Schedules and details live on the event page.

types.q: What can I share besides events?
types.a: Videos, audio, guides and PDFs, downloadable files, links, live sessions, and recipes — plus full courses with sections, lessons, and quizzes. Everything starts as a draft until you choose to publish.

paid.q: Can I charge for resources and courses?
paid.a: Yes — one-off purchases and recurring subscriptions are supported. Paid sales require card payments to be set up through Stripe, and ZoheeWell shows you exactly what is missing before a paid item can go live. Free resources work with no setup at all.

templates.q: Can I reuse content across events and resources?
templates.a: Yes. Start from bilingual starter templates, save your own, and copy them as drafts — including event blueprints for the events you run again and again.

plans.a: Free is $0. Paid plans are Advanced at $49/mo, Pro at $99/mo, Team 25 at $199/mo, and Organization at $499/mo with assisted setup. Annual billing costs ten times the monthly price, so you get two months free. Pricing may change after the pilot, and we will tell you before any change affects you.

fee.q: What fees apply to paid sales?
fee.a: A ZoheeWell platform fee applies to paid sales and gets lower as your plan grows: 5% on Free, 3% on Advanced, 2% on Pro, 1% on Team 25, and 0.5% on Organization. Free offerings have no platform fee. Stripe processing is separate.

founding.q: What is the founding host offer?
founding.a: Personally invited founding hosts get six months of complete access from activation — no card and no automatic conversion, with 30 days' notice before access ends. Founding hosts who choose annual billing by the end of access get 20% off their first paid year; this offer does not stack with the normal annual discount.

payout.a: You are the seller of record. Card payments run through a Stripe connected account that you set up from your plan and payments settings. ZoheeWell shows a readiness checklist and tells you exactly what is left before paid items can go live.

refunds.q: How do refunds and cancellations work?
refunds.a: You set the cancellation and refund policy for each event — choose a template or write your own, and attendees see it before they register. Refunds themselves are handled by you as the seller through your Stripe account.

sms.a: Optional channels like SMS are paid add-ons that only apply if you turn them on. Any charges are shown before you enable them.

find.q: How do I find events, resources, or coaches?
find.a: Open Discover and browse the Events, Resources, and Coaches tabs. Search and filters help you narrow things down by category, date, and location. Everything listed is public — no account needed to look.

coachProfile.q: What is a public coach profile?
coachProfile.a: Hosts can publish a public page with their own link, showing the details, upcoming events, and offerings they choose to share. If a host has not published a profile, nothing is shown.

location.a: Hosts choose whether their city appears on their public profile. Events show the location details the host chose to make public, and everything else stays private.

account.q: Do I need an account to attend?
account.a: No — guests can RSVP from an event link without an account. A free account lets you save events, keep your registrations in one place, and access resources you have purchased or enrolled in.

team.q: Can I work with a team?
team.a: Yes. Teams let several people run events and content together. Included hosts cover the owner, admins, hosts, and content editors; check-in staff, analysts, and moderators never use a seat.

whoManages.q: Who can see and manage my content?
whoManages.a: Only people you assign. A host or manager sees participants for the offerings they manage, and team leadership alone never reveals attendee contact details.

help.a: Use the Support page to send us a message — billing, technical, and account questions all land in the same place. If you are signed out, you will be asked to sign in first so we can reply to the right account.

trouble.q: Something is not working — what should I try?
trouble.a: Check your connection and refresh the page first; ZoheeWell is built for phones and desktops, including slower connections. If the problem continues, send it to us through Support with a screenshot if you can.

sections.p: ZoheeWell is a place for teams to plan and run gatherings together. By creating an account you agree to these terms.
You must be 18 or older to create an account. Keep your sign-in secure and tell us if you think someone else is using it.
You own what you post. You give us permission to show it to the people you share it with. Do not post anything unlawful, hateful, or misleading.
Do not make health, medical, weight-loss or income claims in gatherings, messages or templates. We may remove content that does.
Paid plans renew until you cancel. Ticket sales are between the host and the guest; refunds follow the host's choices and these terms.
You can delete your account from Me at any time. We may pause accounts that break these terms.
Questions about these terms? Reach out through the support link in the app.
Your name, email, optional phone, language, and the gatherings, trainings and challenges you join. We do not collect sales or income data.
To run your team space, send the reminders you ask for, and keep the service safe.
Your team sees your name and activity. Guest contact details are visible only to the gathering's host and team leaders.
Change notification settings in Me, unsubscribe from any email, reply STOP to texts, or delete your account.
Photos are stored privately and shown through short-lived links. We keep data only as long as your account is active.
Questions about your data? Reach out through the support link in the app.
As a host you plan gatherings, welcome guests and keep things safe and friendly.
Use guest contact details only to communicate about your gatherings. Never sell or share them.
Describe gatherings accurately. No health, medical, weight-loss or income claims.
If you sell tickets, you are responsible for refunds when you cancel. ZoheeWell keeps a small platform fee based on your plan.
Choose safe locations, follow local rules, and stop a gathering if anyone is at risk.
When you RSVP we keep your name, the contact details you give, and whether you checked in.
Only the host and the team's leaders can see your contact details. Other guests only see initials.
We send confirmations and reminders only if you opt in. You can stop them any time.
Cancel your RSVP with your confirmation link, or ask the host to remove you.
If you opt in, you'll get texts about gatherings you RSVP to: confirmations, reminders and changes. Usually 1–4 messages per gathering.
Message and data rates may apply.
Reply STOP to any message to stop all texts. Reply HELP for help.
Opting in is not required to RSVP.
We store your sign-in session, language and theme on your device so the app works.
If analytics is turned on, we count page visits and actions with an anonymous ID. No advertising cookies.
You can clear site data in your browser at any time; you'll be signed out.

about.metaDesc: ZoheeWell gives wellness hosts, coaches, and teams one connected home for events, courses, communication, and discovery. Learn what we are building and why.
about.label: About ZoheeWell
about.title: Life is better together.
about.sub: ZoheeWell is one connected home for the people who bring wellness communities together — events and retreats, courses and resources, communication, and a public page where new people can find you.
about.whatTitle: One home instead of five tools
about.whatBody: Hosts today juggle a ticketing page, a group chat, a spreadsheet, a payment app, and a link-in-bio. ZoheeWell brings the pieces together: create an event or retreat, share one link, take RSVPs and check people in, teach with courses and quizzes, and keep the conversation going — in English and Spanish.
about.whoTitle: Built for people who gather people
about.whoSub: ZoheeWell welcomes independent coaches, studios, educators, creators, and community builders of every kind. Many of our earliest hosts come from relationship-led wellness networks — communities built on personal invitation — and the platform is designed to serve them and everyone beyond them.

Yes. Manage your subscription in Me → Plan. Cancel before your next renewal; your current plan stays active through the paid period.

You do, with a rule you pick for each paid event or Circle: full refund until 24 hours before, until 7 days before, or no refunds. Guests see your rule before they pay, and anything you cancel is refunded in full.
